$comment: Provenance manifest for clinicfinder.co.za data. Declares, per VALUE CLASS, where each value came from. Modelled on SDMX observation-status flags (Eurostat/IMF/FAO).

levels.sourced: Taken from a named third-party open-data source.
levels.derived: Computed from other values in this dataset.
levels.ai_authored: Explanatory prose written by AI over sourced material.
levels.observed: Directly measured by our own tooling at a point in time.
levels.config: Site configuration or build artefact authored by our own tooling — sitemap priorities, routing. Not a factual claim about the world.

facilities.json.name: sourced
facilities.json.operator_type: sourced, with 16 records corrected to derived (see notes)
facilities.json.province: sourced, with 130 records corrected to derived (see notes)

primary_sources: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (1,058 facilities) — community-maintained open data, ODbL licensed.
Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team / HOTOSM exports (18 facilities).
notes: Facility records are SOURCED from open data, not modelled — do not hedge them as estimates. The honest caveat here is different: OpenStreetMap is community-maintained, so completeness and currency vary by area. That is a coverage caveat, not a provenance one, and data_quality_score plus last_verified exist to expose it.
This is a humanitarian site. A wrong clinic address costs someone a trip they may not be able to afford, so the coverage caveat matters more here than anywhere else in the portfolio.

2026-08-14 21:10 SAST — `province` was wrong on 130 of 1,076 facility records (12%), always naming a NEIGHBOURING province. Found by point-in-polygon testing each record's own sourced `coordinates` against the 52 SA district-municipality boundaries (click_that_hood south-africa.geojson) mapped to their provinces. The 130 sit a median 26 km inside the province their coordinates fall in, so this is not boundary noise: Kimberley Hospital was filed under Free State, Ermelo Hospital under KwaZulu-Natal, Sebokeng Hospital under North West, Beaufort West Hospital under Northern Cape. For those records `province` is now DERIVED from `coordinates`, which remain sourced and untouched; the sourced value is not otherwise edited anywhere. 8 of the 130 sit within 3 km of the old province's border and were each confirmed against the town named in their own `address.city` before being changed.

2026-08-19 — `operator_type` was "public" on 16 retail pharmacies (Clicks x3, Dis-Chem x2, Medicross, The Local Choice x2, and 8 independent chemists), all of which also carry the OSM shape label type="clinic". Those two values together rendered the public-primary-care editorial block, which tells the reader a clinic is the front door of the public health system, nurse-driven and free. For those 16 `operator_type` is now DERIVED from the operator identity in `name` (a named national retail pharmacy chain or a private retail chemist is not a public facility); `name`, `type` and every other sourced value are untouched. `type` is left as sourced because it is an honest record of what OSM tags the site as; the reader-facing gate now reads `operator_type`, not `type`.
